title: Alfonsina Storni's birth chart
metaDescription: Alfonsina Storni's chart, computed from a sourced birth date: Sun at 8.5° Gemini. Birth time unknown, so no houses or rising sign.
lede: The Moon stands at 21.6° Cancer, in domicile — the planet in its own sign, running on home rules. Of everything the chart can be read for without a birth time, that is the loudest single fact in it.

blocks.title: Where the Sun actually stood
blocks.text: The Sun's exact place is 8.5° Gemini. That falls in the first decan, 0°–10°, sub-ruled by Mercury in the classical scheme — an air sign read through a mutable season.

blocks.title: The personal registers
blocks.text: Closer in, Mercury stands at 16.6° Taurus; Venus stands at 19.6° Cancer; Mars stands at 9.7° Aquarius. The tradition reads a mind that trusts the measured and the checked from Mercury, taste tuned to mood and undertow from Venus, drive that argues its way forward from Mars.

blocks.title: The angles that hold
blocks.text: Start where the chart is tightest — the Sun conjunction Pluto, 0.2° of separation. The tradition stops reading a conjunction as two things. It is one appetite with two names, and it moves together or not at all. Behind it, the Sun conjunction Neptune at 0.2°, and Neptune conjunction Pluto at 0.4° — both still well inside the orbs this site uses. These are the day-proof angles — present at midnight, present at noon, present at the next midnight.

blocks.title: What the angles build
blocks.text: Uranus stands apart from every major angle the day held — the tradition reads an unaspected planet as a voice that speaks on its own schedule, unmodulated by the rest of the chart.

blocks.title: The classical map
blocks.text: The classical table has one entry for this chart. The Moon in Cancer at 21.6° is in domicile — the planet in its own sign, running on home rules. None of these labels is a verdict on a person; they describe how a function is situated, nothing more.

blocks.title: The shape of the whole
blocks.text: Among the 10 placements whose signs hold for the whole day, the elements divide 4 air, 3 water, 2 earth, 1 fire; by modality, 4 mutable, 3 cardinal, 3 fixed. An air emphasis is read as distance for the sake of clarity: the idea gets examined before it gets adopted. Uranus was retrograde — apparent retreat against the stars, which the old reading takes as a function working from the inside first.

blocks.title: The Moon, and how far it can move
blocks.text: The Moon stayed in Cancer for the whole of that day at the birthplace, covering 13.7° between midnight and midnight. The missing clock moves the Moon by half a sign at most here, and the boundary was never close. At the noon reference it stands at 21.6°.
